title: 詞性辨析與易混淆字
subtitle: Word Forms & Confusables
summary: 多益 Part 5 有近三分之一是同字根四選項。這一章把字尾規律與最常考的混淆字整理成可背的表。

blocks.value: 有些 -ly 結尾的是形容詞不是副詞：friendly, costly, likely, timely, orderly, monthly。它們不能拿來修飾動詞。

blocks.q: The department submits a _____ report to headquarters.
blocks.explain: 修飾名詞 report 要用形容詞；monthly 雖以 -ly 結尾，卻是形容詞「每月的」。

sections.title: 人 vs 事：-er / -ee / -ment 的差別

rows: employer 雇主 / employee 員工
attendant 服務員 / attendee 出席者

blocks.value: 空格若指人（可搭配 who、hire、promote），選人的名詞；若指抽象概念（可搭配 increase、require），選事的名詞。

items.en: All attendees must register at the front desk.
items.zh: 所有出席者須在櫃檯報到。

items.en: Attendance at the safety briefing is mandatory.
items.zh: 安全簡報的出席是強制的。

blocks.q: The company provides financial _____ to employees pursuing further education.
blocks.explain: provides 的受詞是抽象的「協助」，用不可數名詞 assistance。assistant 是人。

rows: 動詞影響 / 名詞效果
The delay affected sales. / It had an effect.
躺（不及物）/ 放置（及物）
the principal reason / a guiding principle
complement the design / pay a compliment
向人保證 / 確保 / 投保
assure the client / ensure accuracy / insure the cargo
經濟（領域）的 / 節省的
值得敬重的 / 各自的

blocks.q: Please _____ that all forms are signed before submission.
blocks.explain: ensure = 確保（某事發生），後接 that 子句。assure 的受詞必須是人。

sections.title: 同義但用法不同的動詞

rows: He told me that he agreed.
She explained the policy to us.
Please inform staff of the change.
We notified them of the delay.
remind sb. to V / of sth.

blocks.value: explain、announce、suggest、mention 後面不能直接接人：explain me the rule（錯）→ explain the rule to me。

blocks.q: The HR department will _____ all employees of the new policy next week.
blocks.explain: notify sb. of sth. 是正確搭配。announce 與 explain 不能直接接人當受詞。

items: 永遠複數：goods 貨物、belongings 隨身物品、premises 房舍、savings 存款、earnings 收益、headquarters
看似複數其實單數：news 消息、economics 經濟學、statistics（學科時單數）
單複數同形：series, species, means, headquarters
集合名詞：staff, team, committee, management 在美式英文多用單數動詞

items.en: The company's headquarters is located in Singapore.
A means of transportation is provided.

blocks.q: The latest _____ on consumer spending was released this morning.
blocks.explain: 此處指「統計數據（資料）」，用 statistics；was 是因為視為整體資料集。
